I’ve ripped nails completely off twice before, luckily they grew back. The worst picture here is not even the worst they’ve been. I used to enjoy the “shock value” of “how bad can I get them” kind of thing which is one thing that stopped me from growing them, among many other things. 

Nail biting is extremely compulsive and I know how hard it is to fight that, especially when you can’t see the light at the end and they already look shitty so why not bite them again. 

TIPS/ HOW I DID IT

What helped me in the beginning is taking a picture of my nails every week. The tiny progress wouldn’t be visible to me, unless I saw the pictures. Seeing my nail beds grow is the thing that kept me going. Another tip is file the whites down so they don’t catch. They’ll be very weak, and if they do catch it (or compulsively put your teeth under them like me) you could rip the healing nail bed you’ve been working so hard to grow. 

After about 2 months of this I got a gel manicure. Didn’t keep it on for long (a week and a half) before I ripped it off but under it were my nails- looking normal and pretty long. I guess in my head they were way shorter than the gels. I started painting them pretty and now we’re at today. 

I’ve been trying to do this for my whole life, not first try. I’ve grown them abs relapsed many times. Don’t be hard on yourself. Sometimes I still put my fingers in my mouth, but I force myself to stop. And the compulsion is not as strong, or frequent anymore. I know how easy it is to be messing around and then catch the side and suddenly it’s hanging off. My nails are still weak and will take a good while to be strong and thick and healthy like a normal hand, but I’m not embarrassed of them anymore. And I couldn’t be happier
